authors_zh: Zhilin Wang、Alexander Bukharin、Olivier Delalleau、Daniel Egert 等

one_line: HelpSteer2-Preference: Complementing Ratings with Preferences contributes a preference/reward feedback data object or construction method.
将 HelpSteer2 的多维评分补充为成对偏好数据，并比较评分监督与偏好监督对奖励模型训练的作用。
why: It exposes a reusable preference or reward-feedback data surface that requires provenance and bias audit before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Data-related preference and reward-feedback paper selected for the local L4 collection.

title: Problem
问题
html: HelpSteer2-Preference: Complementing Ratings with Preferences treats preference/reward feedback as a data-construction problem. Its data object is Pairwise preference annotations added to HelpSteer2. The concrete boundary is Rating and Bradley–Terry reward models are often compared on mismatched data. This makes provenance, annotator or teacher identity, and split policy part of the result rather than implementation detail.

《HelpSteer2-Preference: Complementing Ratings with Preferences》把偏好与奖励反馈视为数据构建问题。其数据对象是“HelpSteer2 的成对偏好标注”。要解决的边界是：同一批评分数据究竟更适合回归式奖励模型还是 Bradley–Terry 偏好模型，常因数据不匹配而无法比较。 因而来源、标注者或教师身份以及数据切分不是实现细节，而是结论的一部分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The central contribution is The work adds purpose-built pairwise labels to multi-attribute ratings, enabling a data-matched comparison of regression and preference RMs. The feedback contract must name what is compared or scored, who supplies the signal, and how it becomes a training or selection decision. It belongs in this collection because the paper changes the construction, curation, or interpretation of reusable preference evidence.
核心贡献在于：该工作为既有多属性评分补充专门的成对偏好标注，使两种奖励模型能在数据匹配条件下比较。 反馈契约必须说明比较或评分的对象、信号提供者，以及信号如何进入训练或选择决策。该工作进入本集合，是因为它改变了可复用偏好证据的构建、策展或解释方式。

title: Method
方法
html: Inputs are prompts or candidate outputs plus the stated feedback source; outputs are labeled pairs, scores, weights, or a selection decision. The work adds purpose-built pairwise labels to multi-attribute ratings, enabling a data-matched comparison of regression and preference RMs. A reproducible release should retain source row IDs, generation settings, label/rubric version, filtering decision, split, and artifact revision. Training use must be kept separate from evaluation use.
输入是提示或候选输出及其声明的反馈来源；输出是带标签的成对数据、分数、权重或选择决定。该工作为既有多属性评分补充专门的成对偏好标注，使两种奖励模型能在数据匹配条件下比较。 可复现发布应保留来源行号、生成设置、标签/量规版本、过滤决定、数据切分和工件版本，并严格区分训练用途与评测用途。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Evidence: The paper and dataset are public and the work was accepted to ICLR 2025; pin prompts, candidates, attributes, and label revision. Treat reported gains as conditional on the base model, scorer or teacher, sampling budget, data mixture, and evaluation protocol. Check whether the same judge, prompts, or distribution appears in both curation and evaluation before attributing gains to data quality.
证据边界：论文与数据页给出公开数据，并获 ICLR 2025 接收；复现应固定题目、候选生成、评分属性与偏好标注版本。 所有增益均依赖底座模型、评分器或教师、采样预算、数据混合和评测协议。归因于数据质量前，应检查同一裁判、提示或分布是否同时参与了策展与评测。

title: Novelty
新意
html: What changes is the data decision itself: The work adds purpose-built pairwise labels to multi-attribute ratings, enabling a data-matched comparison of regression and preference RMs. The direction signal is that feedback quality is not only label count; lineage, disagreement, selection rule, and usable uncertainty can change downstream alignment. This is not proof that one automatic signal universally represents human values.
它真正改变的是数据决策本身：该工作为既有多属性评分补充专门的成对偏好标注，使两种奖励模型能在数据匹配条件下比较。 方向性启示是，反馈质量不只等于标签数量；血缘、分歧、选择规则和可用的不确定性都会改变下游对齐。它并不证明某一种自动信号能普遍代表人类价值。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Limitations and audit risks: The protocol covers particular tasks and values, not every language or cultural preference. Inspect label agreement, positional or verbosity effects, duplicates, language and domain coverage, subgroup retention, licenses, and benchmark contamination. A public artifact remains insufficient when its prompt, scorer, threshold, or policy is not pinned.
局限与审计风险：偏好只覆盖特定任务和标注协议，不能推断到所有文化、语言或安全价值。 应检查标注一致性、位置或冗长偏差、重复样本、语言与领域覆盖、群体保留率、许可和基准污染。若提示、评分器、阈值或策略没有固定，公开工件仍不足以支持复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Practical use: Use it for controlled studies of scalar ratings versus pairwise preference training. Teams should preserve raw records alongside derived labels and compare the proposed recipe to a raw-data baseline under fixed training hyperparameters. Use a held-out human or independently verified set for threshold selection whenever possible.
实际用途：适合需要在标量评分与二元偏好之间作受控选择的奖励模型研究。 团队应在保留原始记录的同时保存派生标签，并在固定训练超参数下与未策展数据基线比较。只要可能，就用留出的人类评测或独立可核查集合选择阈值。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Reading and replication notes: start from the primary source https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.01257, freeze the exact release revision, and reconstruct the record-level path from prompt to feedback to inclusion. Report failure slices rather than only a global mean: source, task, language, length, risk category, preference margin, and tie/disagreement cases are especially informative.
阅读与复现：从主论文 https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.01257 开始，固定确切发布版本，重建从提示到反馈再到纳入训练的逐条路径。除全局均值外，应报告失败切片：来源、任务、语言、长度、风险类别、偏好间隔以及并列/分歧案例尤其重要。
